title: Reduce helpers 644/660 from width 8 to 7; conditional κ > 0.00173
body:
## Summary

Change the actual PR3133 scalar words and entrance spaces so helpers 644 and 660 have ordinary width 7 instead of 8, then realize the changed inventory with 740 replicas, 6,660 calls and 2,717,280 complete chronological owner roles. This changes the construction and its complete paid histogram; it is not a decimal-precision update or the earlier proposed 7→6 extraction.

The resulting exact complex root lies in `[0.001730006549538841847005, 0.001730006549538841847006]`. Under the documented inherited assumptions and the source-bound full release, the modern joint transfer gives `κ = 0.001730006549538841847005 − 10^(-46) − 10^(-70) > 0.00173`. The complete original strict release and separate exact source/native/owner/physical/prefix/outer binding both pass.

The independently runnable local word/native package is unchanged. The sibling release package adds a 21.8 KB compressed integer primal, a standard-library generator for the literal owner journal, an independent all-row audit, a complete conditional derivation and an explicit long source/native/physical/prefix/outer replay recipe. [Canonical scope and status](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/3606).

## Scope and limits

The finite checks cover both arbitrary-input orientations, all 91 private buffers, exact native phases, source-window and physical-family-safe owners, every chronological pending prefix, the full eight-stratum histogram, and rigorous modern/bootstrapped outer arithmetic. Physical stock is 663,549; the actual prefix is 1,479 bits, the sufficient reserve is 1,512 and the paid reserve is 2,048.

The conditional implication retains the all-size dispatcher/compiler, uniform coefficient/stock and SCALAR/COPY/CLEAR/zero-allocation contracts, common-label/mutable-source physical realization, whole-call hosting, internal recursive rounding, tape costs, retained bootstrap-time constant, exact recovery, PR559 recurrence/correction, analytic transfer and BIT H1–H5 hypotheses. No unconditional theorem, formal-kernel proof, global packing optimum or selected-frontier change is claimed.

The frozen historical source templates are preserved. Their old 3000/3080-digit prose and 15-control summary do not replace the actual precision-24 SPEC/LEDGER or 25-control ASYNC-AUDIT. The new long wrapper's preparation stage was executed; its full tail was not. The original complete release run separately passed and is bound by exact source and validation manifests. Fresh retained bootstrap is supported by the recipe but was not rerun in this session; explicitly reused retained source/receipt/cache bytes are authenticated.

## Test plan

- Original local package: full registered replay, optimized Git-free committed export replay, exact byte/source-history gates, and [automatic CI39111312157](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/39111312157) all pass on `ac92a027c78b0c9bb0ada739b26959afda489d0e`.
- Sibling: registered fresh owner/moment replay passes. The committed source-history and byte gates pass at `c006ddb034f5efcb0706a5d8207d38c367a99ace` (145 declared files). Its Git-free export replay passes under `-I -O` in 63.83s with all 146 regular files, including the export receipt, unchanged. Exact archive SHA256: `8a021a5280b615ad353cd6d0ba489e815ad9995413d72af40584db3b2bf0a692`.
- Three exact moment engines, all 63 modern outer inequalities and 17 controls, and all 47 bootstrap inequalities with four controls pass. Four aggregate corruptions and five separately scoped literal predicates are checked; the complete literal journal is independently audited.
- Portable long preparation passes exact historical exports/source rebuild, both fresh native chains, fresh owners and actual owner/lift/rebind preparation. The original full strict release passed in 1,138.41s; the independent binding authenticates actual 25 controller controls, exact source and complete histogram. [Automatic CI39113623065](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/39113623065) passes on publication head `3efbb5de06a49ffeea6684482f2d3fe48cdca3fb`, including both the unchanged local native package and the new conditional-release package. No manual CI rerun is requested.

Preserve the Yiyang Lu staged-kernel/flow, Nick Petalas copied-owner, Tekalign owner-checker, Marius-Paul Dumitrean endpoint/native, Jeremy Kothe preload/source, dataisfire/PR3361 bootstrap, and native PR2226 lineage with their original source notices and credits.

Prepared by Ross Richardson with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance. Separate AI review is not independent human review. The exact scope, proof, live inputs, freshly executed stages, explicit retained reuse and remaining hypotheses are recorded in the two packages.
